# TASK-167 — Fewer clicks to approve

- **Status:** Done — implemented and verified
- **Area:** Minimal path to a correct specification (2026-10-07)

## Intent

`reviewAll` on baseline approval reviews every section that needs it and has its required answers, then approves. It checks readiness on the would-be-reviewed specification first, so a refused approval writes nothing. The one-click button appears only when reviews are all that is left.

## What it delivers

`reviewAll` in `api/review.ts`, checked on the would-be-reviewed specification first so a refused approval writes nothing. Tests: `tests/minimal-spec.test.ts` (nine sections reviewed and audited, baseline and tasks created, nothing written when refused, editors refused, stale revision refused), `readiness.test.tsx`, and the journey in `e2e/minimal-spec.spec.ts` (one click from "Not ready" to tasks on the board; axe).
